layers.criterion: Model recognition of uncertainty, scope boundaries and stop conditions.
Authorization and environmental assumptions were explicit and correct.
Classifiers, policies, approvals, action limits and trust-boundary checks were operating as intended, including for the human languages, scripts and usage conditions involved.
Credentials, permissions, spending, publishing and execution were appropriately constrained.
Network paths, isolation, targets and data boundaries were independently verified.
Operators detected and interrupted unexpected behavior in real time.
Responsibilities, escalation paths and stop procedures were clear, and people had an opportunity to understand, contest or recover from the outcome.
A partner or third-party dependency (cloud, evaluation, data or tooling provider) upheld assumed controls.
The invoked model, runtime, gateway, cache, proxy and wrapper matched configurations and produced expected results.
The consequential action matches valid authorization at commitment, including delegation, expiry and revocation.
The combined sequence, shared state and interactions did not cross a trust boundary and did not exceed the originating scope.
